name: Mind Mines
summary:
Mind Mines is a pioneering jigsaw puzzle game that transforms over 190 pieces of artwork into interactive jigsaw challenges—each infused with strategic mine detection and logical decision-making.

This isn’t just about fitting pieces together. Every move tests your reasoning: uncover hidden traps, avoid mistakes, and mine your way to  completion. Carefully observe and place—but beware: too many wrong moves could trigger mines and end your session.
